title.value: Handle patient calls for appointments, bills and refills

introduction.value: MUSC Health's voice agent Emily handles 25% of patient calls, booking appointments, taking bill payments and processing prescription refill requests.

method.value: MUSC Health built Emily on SoundHound AI's platform and connected her to its Epic health record, so appointment changes update the chart automatically. She started with confirming and canceling appointments, then added rescheduling, Spanish-language calls, billing and payments, and in July pharmacy refill requests and status checks. She can pass callers to a pharmacy team, and patients can still reach a live person.

outcome.value: Emily has supported more than 2.2 million calls since 2024, handles 25% of patient calls and answers all 92 patient access lines. Staff answer the remaining calls faster, and fewer callers hang up.

source_text.body:
Handle patient calls for appointments, bills and refills
MUSC Health's voice agent Emily handles 25% of patient calls, booking appointments, taking bill payments and processing prescription refill requests.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
MUSC Health built Emily on SoundHound AI's platform and connected her to its Epic health record, so appointment changes update the chart automatically. She started with confirming and canceling appointments, then added rescheduling, Spanish-language calls, billing and payments, and in July pharmacy refill requests and status checks. She can pass callers to a pharmacy team, and patients can still reach a live person.
How it went
Emily has supported more than 2.2 million calls since 2024, handles 25% of patient calls and answers all 92 patient access lines. Staff answer the remaining calls faster, and fewer callers hang up.
Try it yourself
with
Lindy
Copy prompt
Build me a phone assistant for [clinic or office name] that answers patient calls, books or reschedules appointments in [scheduling system], and logs refill requests for staff to review. It should answer billing questions using [billing info source] but must not take payments or submit refills itself. It should pass any call it cannot handle to [staff phone or email]. Before turning it on, show me the call flow and a sample test call for me to approve.
Original source: https://www.pymnts.com/healthcare/2026/ai-agent-emily-books-bills-and-refills-for-musc-health/
